messages:
marta: FYI a community contributor hit a nasty combo on Bun + Deno Deploy when trying our sample app. runtime error: "ReferenceError: globalThis.AbortController is not defined" and TS couldn't resolve types.
devon: Bun's module resolution sometimes prefers CJS if package exports are ambiguous. Deno Deploy wants strict ESM and uses import maps; Bun has weird compat flags too.
ravi: can you paste their package.exports snippet?
marta: they attached it in the repro. basically our conditional exports looked like: `{ " .": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }, "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" }` and package.json also had "type": "module".
sue: two separate issues: 1) the runtime picked the cjs path in Bun in some setups, causing shims to load that expect Node globals; 2) the `./types` export separated from `.` meant editors didn't pick up declarations when bundlers rewrote imports to subpaths.
devon: edge-case: Bun polyfills AbortController differently, and our retry logic uses AbortController for request cancellation. In the cjs build we import a node-abort polyfill which isn't available in Bun/Deno Deploy, hence the crash.
ravi: short-term: add an explicit "./web": "./dist/esm/index.mjs" export and update the Next/Deno/Bun sample to import `@redwood/inference/web`. also publish a patch that avoids requiring the node-specific polyfill by gating it.
sue: longer term: flip exports to ESM-first for `.` and move types into the same export object like " ." : { "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts", "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }. add `module` and `browser` fields to help older bundlers.
marta: agree. we should also add a small sample matrix in CI that runs the sample on Bun v1.x and a Deno Deploy smoke harness to catch regressions.
devon: I'll take the package.json PR (exports + module/browser + types consolidation) and a small build tweak to produce a `.mjs` ESM artifact with stable import semantics. ravi: can you land the retry polyfill guard?
ravi: yes, will change retry util to prefer globalThis.AbortController and fallback to a tiny inlined poly that doesn't pull Node-only deps. also add a runtime check to avoid requiring timers polyfills in ESM paths.
sue: ci-bot, can you create follow-ups?
ci-bot: created tickets #4370 (exports: ESM-first + types under main export), #4371 (Bun + Deno smoke CI), #4372 (retry util polyfill guard)
